svg.title: MCP traffic through Kong AI Gateway
svg.desc: A user calls Agent1 on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, which uses semantic tool search. Agent1 sends MCP requests through a Kong MCP route on the Kong AI Gateway data plane on Amazon EKS. Kong forwards MCP requests to MCP servers on AgentCore, and uses the AI MCP Proxy plugin to expose REST services as MCP tools or to proxy to MCP servers outside AWS. AI Rate Limiting and OpenTelemetry plugins also run on the data plane. Admins manage it from Kong Konnect, and it sends telemetry to an OpenTelemetry backend and usage to Konnect metering and billing.
svg.text: MCP traffic through Kong AI Gateway
AI MCP Proxy turns REST services into MCP tools,
or proxies requests to existing MCP servers.
Solid arrows: MCP and REST requests. Dashed arrows: management, telemetry and metering.
